rows.text: Aces are elite combat pilots and vehicle specialists who live and die by their reflexes. They serve as dogfighters, transport pilots, and gunners across every theater of the Galactic Civil War. Whether behind the stick of a starfighter or manning a turret on a capital ship, an Ace turns any vehicle into a weapon. Many come from military backgrounds; others learned to fly running blockades or racing through asteroid fields.
rows.new: Aces serve as dogfighters, transport pilots, and gunners.

rows.text: Bounty Hunters track, capture, or eliminate targets for pay. They operate under Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificates, Guild contracts, or independently. The profession demands expertise in tracking, combat, investigation, and intimidation. Most Bounty Hunters specialize. Some favor surveillance and ambush, others prefer direct confrontation. The Bounty Hunters' Guild provides structure and steady work; Independents trade that security for freedom of choice.

rows.text: Clone Soldiers are products of the Kaminoan cloning program, bred and trained from birth for military service. Their initial conditioning is narrowly focused on combat operations, but the demands of a galactic war force rapid adaptation. Many Clone Soldiers develop distinct identities and specializations far beyond their original training parameters. They serve as the backbone of the Republic's military forces during the Clone Wars.
rows.new: Clone Soldiers serve as the backbone of the Republic's military forces.

rows.text: Colonists are the settlers, professionals, and entrepreneurs who build civilization on the frontier. They include doctors, merchants, politicians, scholars, and performers: anyone whose primary skills are social, intellectual, or economic rather than martial. On the Outer Rim, where Imperial law is thin and infrastructure thinner, a Colonist's knowledge and connections are survival tools as valuable as any blaster.
rows.new: Colonists are settlers and entrepreneurs who build civilization on the frontier.

rows.text: Commanders lead from the front or from the command center, directing troops and coordinating operations. They are tacticians, strategists, and field leaders who inspire loyalty under fire and make decisions that determine whether people live or die. In the Rebellion, where resources are always scarce and retreat is often impossible, effective command is the difference between a successful operation and a massacre.
rows.new: Commanders lead, directing troops and coordinating operations.
rows.reason: R-CVB-12, with Jason (ADDENDUM 6 @ 38e816be3): the field is the creator's career card; restored to today's text

rows.text: Consulars are Force-sensitives who channel their abilities through diplomacy, healing, and negotiation rather than combat. They serve as mediators, advisors, and scholars of the Force. In the old Jedi Order, Consulars were the negotiators sent to resolve conflicts before lightsabers were drawn. Those who survive in the post-Order galaxy apply those same skills in hiding, serving communities that never know what they truly are.
rows.new: Consulars channel their abilities through diplomacy, healing, and negotiation.

rows.text: Diplomats deal in politics, persuasion, and information. They broker deals, manage alliances, forge supply agreements, and maintain the fragile coalition of systems that supports the Rebellion. A skilled Diplomat can open doors that no amount of firepower can breach, turning enemies into assets and neutral parties into allies through negotiation, charm, or leverage.
rows.new: Diplomats deal in politics, persuasion, and information.
rows.reason: R-CVB-12, with Jason (ADDENDUM 6 @ 38e816be3): the field is the creator's career card; restored to today's text

rows.text: Engineers keep machines running, defenses operational, and technology functioning under impossible conditions. They design, build, repair, and modify everything from weapon systems to communication arrays. In the Rebellion, where equipment is salvaged, repurposed, and held together with improvisation, Engineers are indispensable. They turn captured Imperial hardware into Rebel assets and keep aging ships combat-worthy.
rows.new: Engineers keep machines running, defenses operational, and technology functioning.

rows.text: Explorers chart unknown territory, navigate dangerous hyperspace routes, and survive in environments that would kill most beings. They are pathfinders, scouts, and wilderness experts who push beyond the edges of known space. Many work as independent trailblazers, selling navigational data or guiding expeditions. Others serve as forward scouts for military operations or corporate interests in uncharted regions.

rows.text: Guardians are Force-sensitives who dedicate their abilities to the protection of others. They combine martial training with the Force to serve as defenders, peacekeepers, and warriors of principle. Where Consulars negotiate, Guardians stand between the innocent and those who would harm them. Their combat style integrates lightsaber technique with Force-enhanced physical abilities.
rows.new: Guardians dedicate their abilities to the protection of others.

rows.text: Hired Guns are professional combatants who sell their martial skills to the highest bidder. They work as bodyguards, mercenaries, enforcers, and soldiers of fortune across the Outer Rim. Some are former military; others learned to fight in gladiatorial pits, street gangs, or planetary militias. What they share is an aptitude for violence and a practical understanding of its application.

rows.text: Jedi are members of the ancient monastic order devoted to the light side of the Force. Their training encompasses lightsaber combat, Force abilities, diplomacy, and scholarly study. During the Clone Wars, Jedi serve as generals and peacekeepers for the Galactic Republic. Their Order's traditions span thousands of years, emphasizing selflessness, discipline, and service to the greater good of the galaxy.
rows.new: Jedi serve as generals and peacekeepers for the Galactic Republic.

rows.text: Mystics engage with the Force through intuition, vision, and esoteric knowledge rather than martial discipline. They include seers, prophets, Force-sensitive advisors, and students of arcane traditions outside the Jedi framework. Some serve as spiritual guides to communities that still quietly revere the Force. Others pursue forbidden knowledge, walking the boundary between the light and dark sides.

rows.text: Seekers are Force-sensitives drawn to the wild places of the galaxy, following the Force into uncharted territory. They combine survival skills with Force sensitivity, operating as trackers, hunters, and hermits in the wilderness. Many are self-taught, having discovered their abilities far from any formal training. They tend to develop an instinctive, primal connection to the Force shaped by their environments.

rows.text: Sentinels are Force-sensitives who blend Force abilities with practical, technical skills. They operate in the shadows: investigating, infiltrating, and neutralizing threats through a combination of stealth, technology, and the Force. In the old Order, Sentinels hunted criminals and dark side users in the galaxy's underworld. The survivors apply those same methods against the Empire.

rows.text: Smugglers move cargo across borders that governments prefer to keep closed. They are pilots, con artists, and underworld operators who navigate Imperial blockades, customs inspections, and criminal territories as part of daily business. Many operate under debt to crime lords who hold markers on their ships. On the Outer Rim, where Imperial tariffs and trade restrictions cut off essential supplies, Smugglers are often the only lifeline remote communities have.

Their training covers infantry combat, heavy weapons, survival, and battlefield medicine.

rows.new: Tests new Alliance equipment, weapons, and vehicles under field conditions.

rows.text: Ensures Alliance personnel and supplies move where they need to be. Manages transport assets, schedules, and route security.
rows.new: Ensures Alliance personnel and supplies move where they need to be.

rows.text: Conducts targeted elimination operations against high-value Imperial targets. The darkest work the Alliance authorizes, reserved for threats that cannot be neutralized any other way.
rows.new: Conducts targeted elimination operations against high-value Imperial targets.

rows.text: Sets lofty goals and pursues them relentlessly. The harder the challenge, the more determined the response. Thrives on the pursuit of achievement.
rows.new: Sets lofty goals and pursues them relentlessly.

rows.text: Firm conviction in speech and action. Shows no idleness or weakness, approaching every situation with determined purpose.
rows.new: Firm conviction in speech and action.

rows.text: Remarkable courage in the face of danger. Always willing to take risks to protect others, whether charging a rancor or running into a collapsing building.
rows.new: Remarkable courage in the face of danger.

rows.text: A deep sense of fellowship and loyalty to companions. Believes the bonds between allies are sacred and worth any sacrifice to maintain.
rows.new: A deep sense of fellowship and loyalty to companions.

rows.text: Prudence and forethought. Looks before leaping, plans before acting, and has saved companions from dangerous situations through careful assessment.
rows.new: Prudence and forethought. Looks before leaping, plans before acting.

rows.text: Absolute confidence in one's understanding of the Force and the right path forward. Unwavering conviction that provides stability in uncertain times.
rows.new: Absolute confidence in one's understanding of the Force.

rows.text: Generous to a fault, willing to give time, resources, and energy to those in need. Believes that helping others is its own reward.
rows.new: Willing to give time, resources, and energy to those in need.

rows.text: Mental precision and clear-headedness. Sees through confusion and deception to the essential truth of a situation.
rows.new: Mental precision and clear-headedness.

rows.text: Quick-witted and resourceful. Finds creative solutions to problems and sees angles that others miss.
rows.new: Quick-witted and resourceful. Finds creative solutions to problems.

rows.text: A deep capacity for empathy and concern for others' suffering. Driven to help those in pain, even at personal cost.
rows.new: A deep capacity for empathy and concern for others' suffering.

rows.text: Strong self-assurance without arrogance. Trusts their own abilities and decisions, providing steady leadership when others falter.
rows.new: Strong self-assurance without arrogance. Trusts their own abilities and decisions.

rows.text: Thoughtful and deliberate in all dealings. Weighs the impact of every action on others before proceeding.
rows.new: Thoughtful and deliberate in all dealings.

rows.text: Reliable and steady. Others know exactly what to expect, and that predictability builds deep trust over time.
rows.new: Reliable and steady. Others know exactly what to expect.

rows.text: Unshakeable belief in a chosen path or principle. When committed, nothing short of overwhelming evidence will change course.
rows.new: Unshakeable belief in a chosen path or principle.

rows.text: An insatiable drive to understand the unknown. Seeks knowledge, asks questions, and investigates mysteries that others would leave alone.
rows.new: An insatiable drive to understand the unknown.

rows.text: Total commitment to a chosen cause, person, or goal. Invests fully and follows through regardless of personal cost.
rows.new: Total commitment to a chosen cause, person, or goal.

rows.text: Iron self-control and mental fortitude. Maintains focus and composure when others break, resisting temptation and staying the course.
rows.new: Iron self-control and mental fortitude.

rows.text: An intuitive understanding of others' emotional states. Feels what others feel, which builds profound connections but can also be overwhelming.
rows.new: An intuitive understanding of others' emotional states.

rows.text: Infectious energy and optimism. Approaches every challenge with genuine excitement that lifts the spirits of everyone nearby.
rows.new: Infectious energy and optimism.

rows.text: Deep affection for friends, companions, and the people encountered along the way. Remembers kindnesses and repays them many times over.
rows.new: Deep affection for friends, companions, and the people encountered.

rows.text: Careful stewardship of resources. Wastes nothing, plans ahead, and ensures that what is available stretches as far as possible.
rows.new: Careful stewardship of resources. Wastes nothing, plans ahead.

rows.text: A personal code of conduct that governs behavior regardless of circumstances. Keeps promises, fights fairly, and holds themselves to standards others might abandon.
rows.new: A personal code of conduct that governs behavior.

rows.text: Genuine modesty about one's abilities and accomplishments. Deflects praise, shares credit, and recognizes that every success involves others.
rows.new: Genuine modesty about one's abilities and accomplishments.

rows.text: A sincere belief that the galaxy can be better than it is. Strives toward a vision of how things should be, even when reality falls short.
rows.new: A sincere belief that the galaxy can be better.

rows.text: Self-reliance and personal autonomy. Trusts their own judgment, forges their own path, and refuses to be controlled by others.
rows.new: Self-reliance and personal autonomy.

rows.text: A wellspring of happiness that persists even in dark times. Finds reasons to celebrate, to laugh, and to remind others that life is worth living.
rows.new: A wellspring of happiness that persists even in dark times.

rows.text: A deep commitment to fairness and accountability. Believes that wrongdoing must be answered and that every being deserves equitable treatment.
rows.new: A deep commitment to fairness and accountability.

rows.text: An open heart and genuine affection for others. Charming, tolerant, and deeply caring. Holds a special place for companions and allies.
rows.new: An open heart and genuine affection for others.

rows.text: Flexibility and openness to new ideas. Adapts to changing circumstances without losing core identity, and considers perspectives that conflict with their own.
rows.new: Flexibility and openness to new ideas.

rows.text: The capacity for forgiveness and restraint. Believes in second chances and that defeating an enemy doesn't require destroying them.
rows.new: The capacity for forgiveness and restraint.

rows.text: Understated and unpretentious. Lets actions speak louder than words and avoids drawing attention to personal achievements.
rows.new: Understated and unpretentious.

rows.text: Willing to wait for the right moment. Understands that not every problem requires immediate action and that time often reveals the best path.
rows.new: Willing to wait for the right moment.

rows.text: A healthy sense of personal worth and accomplishment. Takes satisfaction in good work and holds themselves to high standards.
rows.new: A healthy sense of personal worth and accomplishment.

rows.text: Logic and rational analysis guide decision-making. Approaches problems methodically, setting emotion aside to find the most effective solution.
rows.new: Logic and rational analysis guide decision-making.

rows.text: A burning sense of moral correctness. Stands against injustice wherever it appears and cannot abide wrongdoing, even when opposing it is costly.
rows.new: A burning sense of moral correctness.

rows.text: A natural capacity to share in others' pain and joy. Connects with people quickly and deeply, building trust through genuine emotional engagement.
rows.new: A natural capacity to share in others' pain and joy.

rows.text: A willingness to believe in others' good intentions. Extends the benefit of the doubt and builds relationships on faith rather than suspicion.
rows.new: A willingness to believe in others' good intentions.

rows.text: Commitment to physical, mental, and spiritual health, both personal and for those around them. Seeks balance and wholeness in all things.
rows.new: Commitment to physical, mental, and spiritual health.

rows.text: A profound sense of awe at the galaxy's vastness and mystery. Approaches the unknown with excitement rather than fear, finding beauty in the unfamiliar.
rows.new: A profound sense of awe at the galaxy's vastness and mystery.

rows.text: A dependency that demands constant feeding: stimulants, gambling, rare collectibles, or worse. The addiction consumes resources, time, and judgment. Withdrawal is immediate and debilitating.
rows.new: A dependency that demands constant feeding: stimulants, gambling, or worse.

rows.text: An addiction to danger itself. The character seeks out life-threatening situations for the rush, pushing boundaries further each time. Caution feels like suffocation.
rows.new: An addiction to danger itself.

rows.text: A persistent adversary who actively works against the character's interests. This isn't a bounty or a debt. It's personal enmity from someone with the means to act on it.
rows.new: A persistent adversary who actively works against the character's interests.

rows.text: A reputation that precedes the character into every room. Whether deserved or not, people have heard things, and those things close doors and invite trouble.
rows.new: A reputation that precedes the character into every room.

rows.text: Responsibility for maintaining a physical location: a ship, a safehouse, a cantina. The base requires upkeep, draws attention, and creates vulnerability.
rows.new: Responsibility for maintaining a physical location: a ship, a safehouse.

rows.text: A personal betrayal that festers. Either the character was betrayed by someone trusted, or they betrayed someone else. The wronged party wants answers, compensation, or revenge.
rows.new: A personal betrayal that festers.

rows.text: Someone possesses evidence of a secret: holovids, bank records, a murder weapon, and uses it as leverage. The blackmailer's demands stay just manageable enough to maintain compliance.
rows.new: Someone possesses evidence of a secret and uses it as leverage.

rows.text: A price on the character's head, posted by an individual, organization, or government. Bounty hunters and opportunists will come. The only question is when.
rows.new: A price on the character's head.

rows.text: Past actions caused unintended harm to bystanders. The guilt lingers, and the consequences (legal, social, or personal) continue to surface.
rows.new: Past actions caused unintended harm to bystanders.

rows.text: Employed under terms set by someone else. The character takes jobs as directed, with limited say in the assignments. Refusal isn't really an option.
rows.new: Employed under terms set by someone else.

rows.text: A binding agreement with a powerful party that restricts the character's freedom of action. The terms are specific, the penalties for breach are severe.
rows.new: A binding agreement with a powerful party.

rows.text: Responsibility for a group of people who depend on the character for leadership, employment, or protection. Their problems become the character's problems.
rows.new: Responsibility for a group of people who depend on the character.

rows.text: An active criminal record or ongoing criminal entanglement. Law enforcement, bounty hunters, and rival criminals all have reasons to come looking.
rows.new: An active criminal record or ongoing criminal entanglement.

rows.text: Money owed to someone dangerous: a Hutt, a crime lord, a lending institution with enforcement capabilities. The debt compounds, and the creditor's patience has limits.
rows.new: Money owed to someone dangerous: a Hutt, a crime lord.

rows.text: A fall from a position of respect or authority. The character was publicly humiliated, stripped of rank, or cast out of an organization. Rebuilding that standing is a long road.
rows.new: A fall from a position of respect or authority.

rows.text: A binding commitment to a person, group, or cause that regularly demands time, resources, and difficult choices. Walking away isn't an option.
rows.new: A binding commitment to a person, group, or cause.

rows.text: Banished from a homeworld, community, or organization. Return is forbidden or dangerous. The exile carries the weight of severed connections and lost identity.
rows.new: Banished from a homeworld, community, or organization.

rows.text: A catastrophic professional failure: a repair that caused a disaster, an installation that malfunctioned at the worst moment. The character's competence is questioned, and the damage may still be unfolding.
rows.new: A catastrophic professional failure. The character's competence is questioned.

rows.text: Public recognition that cuts both ways. The character is known, which brings opportunities but also unwanted attention, expectations, and people who want something from a famous face.
rows.new: Public recognition that cuts both ways.

rows.text: Family members who depend on the character, or whose actions create complications. Family can be leveraged, threatened, or simply need help at the worst possible time.
rows.new: Family members who depend on the character.

rows.text: A debt of gratitude owed to someone who once provided critical help. The favor will be called in, and the terms won't be negotiable.
rows.new: A debt of gratitude owed to someone who provided critical help.

rows.text: An ideological passion that overrides practical thinking. The character's zeal for a cause, belief system, or crusade pushes them into conflicts that cooler heads would avoid.
rows.new: An ideological passion that overrides practical thinking.

rows.text: A self-appointed role as enforcer of justice in lawless territory. The character intervenes in situations that aren't their business, making enemies of people who prefer the lawlessness.
rows.new: A self-appointed role as enforcer of justice in lawless territory.

rows.text: A pattern of taking dangerous gambles: financial, physical, or strategic. The character pushes the odds and sometimes loses badly, creating cascading problems.
rows.new: A pattern of taking dangerous gambles: financial, physical, or strategic.

rows.text: Custodian of a tradition, belief system, or sacred trust. The responsibility demands specific behaviors, rituals, or sacrifices that complicate daily life.
rows.new: Custodian of a tradition, belief system, or sacred trust.

rows.text: Infamy in certain circles. The character is known for something specific: a crime, a betrayal, a spectacular failure, and that reputation follows them.
rows.new: Infamy in certain circles.

rows.text: A solemn promise that binds the character to a specific course of action. Breaking the oath carries consequences beyond the practical. It means becoming someone who breaks oaths.
rows.new: A solemn promise that binds the character.

rows.text: A fixation on a specific goal, object, or subject that overrides practical judgment. The obsession drives the character into increasingly risky situations.
rows.new: A fixation on a specific goal, object, or subject.

rows.text: A deep reluctance or refusal to use violence. In a galaxy where violence is the default solution, this principle creates constant friction with companions and circumstances.
rows.new: A deep reluctance or refusal to use violence.

rows.text: A pattern of romantic entanglements that create complications: jealous ex-partners, angry families, competing loyalties, or simply being in the wrong place with the wrong person.
rows.new: A pattern of romantic entanglements that create complications.

rows.text: A family name or lineage that carries weight, and expectations. The character is measured against ancestors or relatives, and their actions reflect on the entire line.
rows.new: A family name or lineage that carries weight, and expectations.

rows.text: A duty of care toward a group, community, or institution that regularly requires attention and resources. Neglect carries consequences for others.
rows.new: A duty of care toward a group, community, or institution.

rows.text: A compulsive need to defy authority and break rules. Not for profit or ideology, but for the act itself. This makes the character unreliable in structured environments.
rows.new: A compulsive need to defy authority and break rules.

rows.text: A grievance that demands resolution. Someone wronged the character, or someone the character cares about, and the matter remains unsettled. The need for justice or vengeance shapes every decision.
rows.new: A grievance that demands resolution.

rows.text: Bound in service to another being or organization, with limited personal freedom. The terms may be formal or informal, but the power imbalance is real.
rows.new: Bound in service to another being or organization.

rows.text: Financial backing from a patron who expects results, loyalty, and compliance. The sponsor's resources come with strings, and those strings can be pulled at any time.
rows.new: Financial backing from a patron who expects results, loyalty, and compliance.

rows.text: A compulsive need for excitement and novelty. Routine is intolerable. The character gravitates toward danger not out of courage but out of restlessness.
rows.new: A compulsive need for excitement and novelty.

rows.text: A formal employment agreement that dictates the character's professional obligations. The contract has specific terms, and breaking them has legal and practical consequences.
rows.new: A formal employment agreement that dictates the character's professional obligations.

rows.text: Something left incomplete: a mission, a relationship, a promise. The unfinished matter pulls at the character, demanding resolution that circumstances keep deferring.
rows.new: Something left incomplete: a mission, a relationship, a promise.

rows.text: A self-appointed agent of justice operating outside legal frameworks. The character hunts wrongdoers by their own code, which puts them at odds with both criminals and law enforcement.
rows.new: A self-appointed agent of justice operating outside legal frameworks.

rows.text: The character witnessed something they shouldn't have: a crime, a conspiracy, a secret. Powerful people want them silenced, and staying hidden requires constant vigilance.
rows.new: The character witnessed something they shouldn't have.
